input: Outline a personal finance course for my blog

gold.taskTitle: Outline a Personal Finance Course for Blog
gold.taskDescription: Create a structured course outline on personal finance topics to be published on the user's blog.

questions.title: Who is the target audience for this course?
questions.description: Identify whether the course is aimed at beginners, young adults, families, or a more financially experienced audience.

questions.title: What specific finance topics must be covered?
questions.description: Determine which core subjects the user wants included, such as budgeting, investing, debt management, or retirement planning.

questions.title: How many modules or lessons should the course have?
questions.description: Establish the intended length and depth of the course in terms of number of sections or lessons.

questions.title: Will the course be free or a paid product?
questions.description: Clarify the monetization intent, as this affects how the content is structured, gated, and positioned.

questions.title: What format will each lesson take on the blog?
questions.description: Understand whether lessons will be written articles, embedded videos, downloadable PDFs, or a mix of formats.

questions.title: Is there a publishing deadline or launch date in mind?
questions.description: Determine the timeframe the user is working within to prioritize and pace the outline work.

questions.title: What tone should the course content carry throughout?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants the course to feel academic, conversational, motivational, or strictly practical.
